Package com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.infrastructure.persistence.entity

Class ConversationJpa

java.lang.Object
com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.infrastructure.persistence.entity.ConversationJpa
@Entity public class ConversationJpa extends Object
JPA entity for the conversations table.

Post V005 (US-10-002), ownership is split across two mutually-exclusive nullable associations: ownerUser (UserJpa) and ownerApiKey (ApiKeyJpa). The PostgreSQL constraint ck_conversations_owner_xor guarantees exactly one is non-null at the schema level; the domain mapper additionally asserts the same on read as defense-in-depth.

This entity is a dumb data carrier — it does NOT enforce the XOR in its canonical constructor. The mapper sets exactly one of the two setOwnerUser / setOwnerApiKey calls per write.
